title: From the averaged slice identity to the slice identity for a.e. t, simultaneously for all test forms (Simon Ch. 6, Remark 4.2 and the end of the proof of 4.5(2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let R_T = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P of dimension m+2 (IMRep univ (m+2)), R_∂ = (M', θ', ξ') one of dimension m+1, (R_s)_{s∈ℝ} a family of integer multiplicity triples of dimension m+1 (Rs : ℝ → IMRep univ (m+1)), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel. Write τ(R)(ω) := R.action ω = ∫_N φ⟨ω, ζ⟩ dH^{m+1} for R = (N, φ, ζ), Hᵏ = μHE[k], and γ_{a,b}(s) := min{1, max{0, (b − s)/(b − a)}}. Assume (i) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P), s ↦ τ(R_s)(ω) is locally integrable on ℝ; and (ii) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P) and all real a < b, ∫_a^b τ(R_s)(ω) ds = (b − a)·(∫_M θ γ_{a,b}(f)⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{m+2} − ∫_{M'} θ' γ_{a,b}(f)⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^{m+1}). Then for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, simultaneously for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P): τ(R_t)(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{m+2} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^{m+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (Rs : ℝ → IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Measurable f → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), LocallyIntegrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)))) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1])) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (Rs t).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]
